svg.title: The U.S. loses its measles-elimination status
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. In a pediatric clinic a nurse in mint scrubs leans in with a syringe to vaccinate a toddler held on a parent's lap, while a second family waits in the doorway. Behind them the whole wall is a glowing map of the lower 48 states covered in clusters of red dots with rippling rings, an illustrative symbol of measles spreading. Represents the Pan American Health Organization's Nov. 17, 2026 announcement that the United States has lost its measles-elimination status.
